description: Progressive Change-Driven Development: a CLI and agent instructions that give each change made with AI coding agents (Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity) just enough process — specs, a resumable change record and independent review only when the risk calls for it.
rules: Install the CLI with `uv tool install pcdd` or `pipx install pcdd` (Python 3.9+), then run `pcdd init` in the project root; preview with `pcdd init --dry-run`.
Agents read `AGENTS.md` and `.pcdd/core.md` first and load skills only when needed.
Substantial changes live in `pcdd/changes/<name>.md`, created with `pcdd new <name>`; keep task syntax `- [ ] T1 (S1) description` unchanged because the CLI parses it.
Use `pcdd --json` for machine-readable output; human output is not a parsing contract.
Commits, pushes and publishing require the user's explicit approval; a change is done only after the user accepts it.
